message.text:
Identifying how the compiled React frontend is served in production and locating the corresponding configuration file.

The compiled React frontend is embedded into the Go binary using Go's embed package. It is served via Echo's StaticWithConfig middleware. An SPA fallback middleware serves index.html for client-side routing. Two files wire this mechanism.

The wiring happens in `server/server.go`, where `frontend.NewFrontendService` is invoked. The serving logic itself lives in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.

Identifying the production serving mechanism and its configuration file.

The mechanism is Go `embed.FS` embedding assets into the binary, served by Echo's `StaticWithConfig` middleware with SPA fallback. It is wired in `server/server.go` at lines 71–72.

FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.26.2-alpine AS backend
WORKDIR /backend-build

# Install build dependencies
RUN apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates

# Copy go mod files and download dependencies (cached layer)
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    go mod download

# Copy source code (use .dockerignore to exclude unnecessary files)
COPY . .

# Please build frontend first, so that the static files are available.
# Refer to `pnpm release` in package.json for the build command.
ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH VERSION=dev COMMIT=unknown
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH \
    go build \
      -trimpath \
      -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/usememos/memos/internal/version.Version=${VERSION} -X github.com/usememos/memos/internal/version.Commit=${COMMIT} -extldflags '-static'" \
      -tags netgo,osusergo \
      -o memos \
      ./cmd/memos

# Use minimal Alpine with security updates
FROM alpine:3.21 AS monolithic

# Install runtime dependencies and create non-root user in single layer
RUN apk add --no-cache tzdata ca-certificates su-exec && \
    addgroup -g 10001 -S nonroot && \
    adduser -u 10001 -S -G nonroot -h /var/opt/memos nonroot && \
    mkdir -p /var/opt/memos /usr/local/memos && \
    chown -R nonroot:nonroot /var/opt/memos

# Copy binary and entrypoint to /usr/local/memos
COPY --from=backend /backend-build/memos /usr/local/memos/memos
COPY --from=backend --chmod=755 /backend-build/scripts/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/memos/entrypoint.sh

# Run as root to fix permissions, entrypoint will drop to nonroot
USER root

# Set working directory to the writable volume
WORKDIR /var/opt/memos

# Data directory
VOLUME /var/opt/memos

ENV TZ="UTC" \
    MEMOS_PORT="5230"

EXPOSE 5230

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/memos/entrypoint.sh", "/usr/local/memos/memos"]

message.text:
The React frontend is built with Vite via `pnpm release`, outputting to `server/router/frontend/dist`.

Go's `embed` directive bundles the `dist` directory into the binary. The Echo server serves these files via `middleware.StaticWithConfig`. An SPA fallback middleware returns `index.html` for client-side routes. The wiring happens in `server/server.go` at lines 71-72, where `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(ctx, echoServer)` is called.

The mechanism is `embed.FS` with Echo `Static` middleware. The wiring file is `server/server.go`.

q27.
Go embed.FS with Echo `middleware.StaticWithConfig` (plus SPA fallback to `index.html`); `server/server.go`

In production the compiled React app is built into `server/router/frontend/dist` (via `web/package.json`’s `release` script), then baked into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`. The Echo server serves those embedded files through `middleware.StaticWithConfig`, with SPA fallback middleware for client-side routes.

Registration happens in `server/server.go`:

```71:72:server/server.go
	// Serve frontend static files.
	frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)
```

The embed and static middleware setup live in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`:

```20:21:server/router/frontend/frontend.go
//go:embed dist/*
var embeddedFiles embed.FS
```

```53:59:server/router/frontend/frontend.go
	// Route to serve the frontend static assets.
	e.Use(middleware.StaticWithConfig(middleware.StaticConfig{
		Filesystem: frontendFS,
		Skipper:    skipper,
	}))

	e.Use(spaFallbackMiddleware(frontendFS))
```

There is no separate nginx or static file server in the production Docker image (`scripts/Dockerfile`); the single `memos` binary serves the embedded frontend over HTTP.
